The '''mother''' of [[Garr]]<ref name="Boba Fett: Crossfire" /> was an [[Excargan]]<ref name="The Essential Reader's Companion" /> who worked as an [[Ore/Legends|ore]] trader during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. When the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] [[Battle of Excarga|attacked]] [[Excarga/Legends|Excarga]], [[Gender/Legends|she]] and Garr's [[Garr's father|father]] hid their child while they were made [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]]. After the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Battle of Excarga|counterattack]], Garr's [[Parent/Legends|parents]] were both presumed [[Death/Legends|dead]], and the orphan was taken via the ''[[Candaserri]]'' to an orphanage on [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]]. Garr believed that they were still alive and would someday come to claim their child.<ref name="Boba Fett: Crossfire" />
